steps.caption: Site Scan
steps.narration: This is Site Scan. It reads your website the way a search engine does, and ends in a fix list.

steps.caption: Location, website, pages
steps.narration: Pick a Google Business Profile location and it uses that profile's website, and checks the site against it.

steps.caption: Start scan
steps.narration: Start scan reads your pages in the background, with Google PageSpeed's mobile and desktop test.

steps.caption: Monthly rescans
steps.narration: Turn on a monthly rescan and it runs on its own. These two sites are rescanned every month.

steps.caption: History & score trend
steps.narration: Every scan stays in your history, with its overall score and how far it moved since the scan before.

steps.caption: Open a report
steps.narration: Open the latest scan of this roofing company's site.

steps.caption: Six scores
steps.narration: An overall score, then Local, Content, Technical, Performance and AI Readiness.

steps.selector: summary:has-text("What raised or lowered these scores?")
steps.caption: What moved each score
steps.narration: Open this to see what raised or lowered each one.

steps.selector: article:has-text("Google Maps embed not found") >> nth=0
steps.caption: Every finding, explained
steps.narration: Each finding says why it matters, links Google's own guidance, and lists the steps to fix it.

steps.caption: The fix checklist
steps.narration: The checklist orders the fixes by impact. Each shows its page, and what the last rescan found.

steps.caption: AI plan, PDF, share link
steps.narration: Draft an AI fix plan to review, export a PDF, or create a share link for your web person.

steps.caption: Follow up
steps.narration: Then rescan to check what got fixed, or email them the prioritized checklist.

steps.caption: Menu: Site Scan
steps.narration: You'll find Site Scan in the menu on the left, under Tools.

youtube.title: Site Scan in about a minute | ConstructHUB
youtube.description: A one-minute tour of Site Scan in ConstructHUB: scan your website against your Google Business Profile, read six scores and every finding with steps to fix it, then share the report and rescan to check the fixes.
